labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports a failure in Rich's tests with a newer Pygments release, so it claims a defect.

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: No runnable example, failing test names or Rich version were given.

items.body:
Thanks for the report. To look into the test failures, we need the details of what fails. Please add:

- The names of the failing tests (for example `tests/test_syntax.py::...`) and the first few lines of one failure. The full output is not needed; a short excerpt is enough.
- The Rich version you are building (`pip show rich` or the spec file version) and the Pygments version you tested.
- The output of `python -m rich.diagnose`.

Related earlier report: #3088 (Pygments version support on Fedora).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
